message.jaymospowers.draught.drunk: A chill runs through you, and passes.
message.jaymospowers.cure.deep: You wake lighter than you lay down.
message.jaymospowers.corruption.stage1: You hear your name, very faintly.
message.jaymospowers.corruption.stage3: The air feels thick, and watchful.
research.jaymospowers.flux.text: No working is clean. Every pot that boils, every spill and every spell leaves a little of itself behind, a grey-violet taint that pools in the ground where it was made. It thins slowly, seeps into the next field over, and does not like to be near people.
research.jaymospowers.blight.text: Where the taint lies thick the land sours. Grass and earth turn to a crust of grey-violet soil that creeps on, flowers and crops wilt to nothing, leaves wither on the bough and puddles of goo seep up and drag at the foot. Animals that live there fall sick and turn on whoever walks by. In the worst places small lights drift out at night.
research.jaymospowers.cleansing.text: Salt keeps things as they are, and light drives out what does not belong. Boil an alchemical salt in a pot rich in both for Purifying Salts: thrown, they cleanse the ground and the air where they land. Bottled with life and water they make a Purifying Draught, which takes the lingering taint out of a body. A Ward Stone, built of brick, salts and orichalc, quietly drinks the taint out of its own chunk of land.
research.jaymospowers.whispers.text: Forbidden, and opened only to those who already hear it. The voices are not nothing: there is a dark ink in them, and a way to draw it. A pot rich in Shadow, Mind and Flux turns an ink sac to Shadow Ink. Learning this leaves a mark that no draught reaches.
